title: JD Vance 'worried' about Taylor Swift, Travis Kelce wedding. He was wrong

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: JD Vance 'worried' about Taylor Swift, Travis Kelce wedding. He was wrong
sources.description: JD Vance, a Bengals fan, said football fans should be ready to 'push back' against the NFL when asked about Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's wedding.
